newsitem.title: USA: Pillsbury recalls Date Quick Bread for due to nuts.
newsitem.headline: Pillsbury recalls Date Quick Bread for due to nuts.

text.p: Pillsbury said on Wednesday it is recalling some packages of its one-pound, 0.6-ounce Date Quick Bread Mix, which may contain walnuts and almonds not declared on the packaging.
Pillsbury, which is a unit of Grand Metropolitan Plc, said the mislabelled Pillsbury Date Quick Bread Mix could cause a severe allergic reaction in persons with sensitivity to almonds or walnuts.

Only packages of Pillsbury Date Quick Bread Mix with production codes beginning with the five characters C6M20 are being recalled. The ten-character production code can be found on the top of the box.
The product with those codes are being recalled from consumers and grocery stores nationally.
The product poses no other health risk, Pillsbury said. No illness has been reported.
